title: cordula druryi
intro: Cordula druryi, commonly known as Cordia drupifera, is a plant species within the Boraginaceae family. It is a flowering plant native to the tropical regions of Central and South America. Research suggests that Cordula druryi has several health benefits, including its potential to lower blood pressure and act as an antioxidant, which may contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of Cordula druryi include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
